records.issue_text: **11. Error toast formatting is user-hostile and has dead code.** `AddGuestsDialog.tsx:38-41`: `const message = ` + "`${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`" + ` always produces a truthy string, so the `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` fallback is unreachable and the newly-added `unable_to_add_guests` string is never displayed. Drop the raw tRPC code from the user-facing text and use the fallback for unknown errors.
records.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` onError, `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` will always produce a non-empty string (even if parts are undefined), so `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` can never hit the fallback. This makes the `unable_to_add_guests` locale string effectively unreachable and forces a potentially unhelpful `code:` prefix into user-facing text.
